title: Snappoints
description: Snap-point definitions for a component. Accepts an array of individual snap points, a grid shortcut object, or a mixed array containing both.

id.description: Optional stable identifier for this snap point.

position.description: Local-space position of the snap point.

rotation.description: Local-space rotation of the snap point in degrees.

tags.description: Filter tags (e.g. 'top', 'side', 'face') for snap compatibility rules.

allowedTags.description: Only snap objects carrying at least one of these tags may connect here.

enabled.description: Whether this snap point is active at spawn.

gridShortcut.title: SnapGrid
gridShortcut.description: Procedurally generates a rectangular grid of snap points.

spacing.description: Gap between adjacent snap points. Number = uniform; [x,z] = per-axis; [x,y,z] = full 3D step.

origin.description: Local-space position of the grid's [0,0] corner. Defaults to [0,0,0].

rotation.description: Rotation applied to every generated snap point.

tags.description: Tags applied to every generated snap point.

allowedTags.description: Snap-compatibility filter applied to every generated snap point.

idPrefix.description: If set, each generated snap point receives id '<idPrefix>_<row>_<col>'.

centered.description: When true, the grid is centered on the origin rather than starting from it.

oneOf.description: Mixed array of individual snap points and/or grid shortcuts.
Bare grid shortcut (expanded to an array by the loader).
